title: Optimize columnar vector search result preallocation
constraints: Preserve columnar vector search distance, limit, and ordering semantics
rationale: Columnar vector search truncates and sorts scored candidates before building the returned rows. At that point the final result count is known, so preallocating the output vector avoids growth during result materialization.
steps: Replace final iterator collect with explicit output vector construction
Preallocate output rows from retained scored candidate count
Keep distance calculation, limit trimming, and sorting unchanged
Verify columnar vector search and hybrid zero-limit behavior
expected_impact: Reduces allocation churn during columnar vector search result materialization without changing result order.
